recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy composition featuring two young athletes in mid-air, framed by a circular jump rope against a heavily textured, vibrant yellow background with bold, distressed stencil lettering at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction with the circular jump rope frame
Contrast between vibrant yellow background and dark subject silhouettes
Relationship between the distressed background texture and the weathered typography
Dynamic diagonal movement of the jumping figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures, scaled to occupy the middle 60% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to create movement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white display text at the top and the circular rope that leads the eye around the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top text, follows the curve of the rope down to the subjects' feet, and arcs back up through their expressive arm gestures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Active negative space filled with yellow grunge texture and red scratch marks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value background contrasting with mid-tone subjects and bright white highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Visible stencil gaps in vertical strokes
Rough, eroded edges simulating spray-paint or weathered woodblock
Slightly irregular baseline for a hand-placed look
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point integrated into the blocky rhythm
Dot-matrix or halftone texture applied to the fill of the letters

composition.overlap: Slightly behind the rope or subject hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face; secondary information should be a clean, modern sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the industrial stencil look with appropriate weight.
Provides the necessary eroded, grungy texture within a stencil frame.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant yellow background with heavy grunge texture, red scratches, and a circular jump rope framing the center. Place two energetic teenagers jumping in mid-air inside the rope frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, white, distressed stencil-style lettering at the top of the image with a subtle drop shadow and halftone texture inside the glyphs.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow background sufficiently textured and vibrant?
Does the rope form a clear circular frame around the subjects?
Is the typography distressed and stencil-like?
Do the subjects appear to be in dynamic, jumping poses?

adjustableVariables: Level of erosion on the typography

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between white text and yellow background

postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone texture in the white text
Ensure the rope has a realistic braided texture
Verify the red scratches look like physical marks on a surface
Confirm the jumping poses feel natural and energetic
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Vibrant Textured Background] + [Circular Framing Device] + [Dynamic Action Subject] + [Distressed Stencil Display Type] for a high-energy youth-oriented layout.
